slides.title: Start with a hook
slides.body: Open with the promise of the episode in a single sentence.

slides.title: Name the problem
slides.body: Show the friction your audience already feels.

slides.title: Share the method
slides.body: Break the solution into three concrete steps.

slides.title: Prove it works
slides.body: Add a result, a number, or a short story.

slides.title: Close with a call to action
slides.body: Tell the viewer exactly what to do next.
